# CmisCdbCommandId5p4 — CMIS CDB Command ID Groups (CMIS 5.4 and later)

<!-- Generated by openxcvr-codegen --lang markdown. DO NOT EDIT. -->

- Schema: `openxcvr.enum.v2` (kind `enum`), id `CmisCdbCommandId5p4`
- Description: CDB command ID group registry as printed by CMIS 5.4 Table 9-1 (p. 325). CmisCdbCommandId keeps the pre-5.4 window, where the whole 0x4100..0x7fff span is 'Restricted for use by OIF'; CMIS 5.4 allocates the first block, 0x4100..0x41ff, to the Coherent CMIS (C-CMIS) supplement and re-describes the remainder as OIF block allocation space for supplement documents. Revision-blind duplicate/overlap rules forbid splitting the span in place, so the since-5.4 group set lands here, following the CmisBanksSupported5p4 precedent (ADV-01).
- Spec: `cmis` revision `5.4`
- Provenance: spec: CMIS 5.4 § 9.1 / Table 9-1 · pdf_pages: 325
- Revision applicability: revision-qualified — entry revision windows are interpreted within the known CMIS family domain (3.0, 4.0, 5.0, 5.1, 5.2, 5.3, 5.4); entries without a window apply throughout that domain only, never outside it
